# Wiley
> Wiley is a global publisher and research company providing journals, books, learning resources, and publishing services for researchers, educators, institutions, societies, and industry.

Wiley operates across scholarly publishing, professional learning, academic course materials, and institutional solutions. Its web presence spans author services, journal and book publishing, open access, society partnerships, corporate and healthcare solutions, and the Wiley Online Library research platform.

## Main Platforms
- [Wiley Online Library](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/): Research platform for journals, books, reference works, and databases across disciplines.
- [Wiley Homepage](https://www.wiley.com/): Corporate entry point for publishing, learning, and institutional solutions.
- [Author Services](https://authorservices.wiley.com/): Central hub for manuscript preparation, submission, publication, and promotion support.
- [Open Access](https://authorservices.wiley.com/open-research/open-access/index.html): Information on Wiley open access publishing models, policies, and funding support.
- [Research Exchange](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers/research-exchange): Manuscript submission and peer review workflow platform for publishers and societies.

## Publishing for Authors
- [Publish with Wiley](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/publish): Overview of journal, article, and book publishing options for authors.
- [Publish an Article](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/publish/article): Guidance for article submission, journal selection, and peer review.
- [Publish a Book](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/publish/book): Book publishing information for prospective authors and editors.
- [Journal Finder](https://journalfinder.wiley.com/search?type=match): Tool to identify suitable Wiley journals for a manuscript.
- [Author Services Home](https://authorservices.wiley.com/): End-to-end support for preparing, submitting, and publishing research.
- [Prepare Your Manuscript](https://authorservices.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/Prepare/manuscript-preparation-guidelines.html): Practical manuscript preparation guidance for journal authors.
- [Submit Your Manuscript](https://authorservices.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/Submission/submission.html): Submission process overview and links to journal submission systems.

## Open Research and Policies
- [Open Research](https://authorservices.wiley.com/open-research/index.html): Wiley’s open research hub covering open access, data sharing, and transparency.
- [Open Access](https://authorservices.wiley.com/open-research/open-access/index.html): Overview of gold open access options, licenses, and compliance topics.
- [Copyright, License and Permissions](https://authorservices.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/licensing/licensing-info-faqs.html): Licensing and permissions information for journal authors.
- [Data Sharing](https://authorservices.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/open-access/data-sharing-citation.html): Guidance on data sharing, citation, and related author practices.
- [Publication Ethics](https://authorservices.wiley.com/ethics-guidelines/index.html): Ethics guidance for authors, reviewers, editors, and publishing partners.
- [Funders and Institutions](https://authorservices.wiley.com/open-research/open-access/for-authors/funder-agreements.html): Information on open access agreements and funder compliance support.

## Journals and Online Library
- [Browse Publications](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/action/showPublications): Directory of Wiley journals, books, and reference publications.
- [Journals A-Z](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/action/showPublications?pubType=journal): Alphabetical listing of Wiley journals across subject areas.
- [Books A-Z](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/action/showPublications?pubType=book): Alphabetical listing of Wiley books and major reference works.
- [Subjects](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/subjects): Subject-based navigation for research content on Wiley Online Library.
- [Current Issues](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/action/showPublications?pubType=journal&target=default): Access point for active journals and current publication content.
- [Early View](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/earlyview): Recently accepted and published-ahead-of-issue journal articles.
- [Accepted Articles](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/accepted-articles): Collection of accepted manuscripts posted before final publication.

## Books, Textbooks, and Learning
- [Books](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/books): Wiley books catalog across professional, academic, and technical subjects.
- [Textbooks and Courseware](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/textbooks): Course materials and textbook resources for instructors and students.
- [For Instructors](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/textbooks/instructors): Instructor resources for course adoption, teaching materials, and support.
- [For Students](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/textbooks/students): Student-focused access to learning materials and study support.
- [WileyPLUS](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/wileyplus): Digital teaching and learning platform for higher education courses.
- [Custom Learning Solutions](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/corporates/custom-content-solutions): Custom content and learning materials for organizations and programs.

## Solutions for Institutions
- [Solutions and Partnerships](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships): Overview of Wiley offerings for institutions, societies, and organizations.
- [Academic Institutions](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/academic-institutions): Solutions for universities, libraries, and research organizations.
- [Libraries](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/academic-institutions/libraries): Journal, ebook, and database access solutions for academic libraries.
- [Hospitals and Healthcare](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/hospitals-healthcare): Clinical and professional resources for hospitals and healthcare organizations.
- [Corporates](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/corporates): Research, learning, and content solutions for corporate teams.
- [AI and Research Development](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/corporates/ai-research-development): Research intelligence and AI-enabled solutions for R&D organizations.
- [Marketing Solutions](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/corporates/marketing-solutions): Content-driven marketing solutions built on Wiley audiences and expertise.

## Societies and Publishers
- [Societies and Publishers](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers): Partnership offerings for scholarly societies and publishing organizations.
- [For Societies](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers/societies): Publishing, membership, and strategic support for academic societies.
- [For Publishers](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers/publishers): Services and infrastructure for publishing partners and content owners.
- [Research Exchange](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers/research-exchange): Submission and peer review workflow solution for partner journals.
- [Journal Publishing Services](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers/journal-publishing): Journal publishing support spanning editorial, production, and dissemination.
- [Book Publishing Services](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers/book-publishing): Book publishing services for societies and partner organizations.

## Author Resources and Workflow
- [Journal Authors](https://authorservices.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/index.html): Resource center for journal authors from preparation through publication.
- [Book Authors](https://authorservices.wiley.com/author-resources/book-authors/index.html): Guidance and support resources for Wiley book authors.
- [Peer Review](https://authorservices.wiley.com/Reviewers/journal-reviewers/index.html): Information and guidance for journal peer reviewers.
- [Editors](https://authorservices.wiley.com/Reviewers/journal-editors/index.html): Resources for journal editors managing editorial workflows.
- [Accepted Articles and Production](https://authorservices.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/Publication/accepted-articles.html): What happens after acceptance, including production and publication steps.
- [Promote Your Article](https://authorservices.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/Promotion/promoting-your-article.html): Tips and tools for increasing article visibility after publication.

## Support and Help
- [Customer Help](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/support): Support portal for orders, access, accounts, and product assistance.
- [Contact Us](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/contact): Contact options for Wiley departments, products, and regional teams.
- [Permissions](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/permissions): Rights and permissions information for reusing Wiley content.
- [Accessibility](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/accessibility): Accessibility information for Wiley websites, products, and services.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/terms-and-conditions): Terms and conditions governing use of Wiley websites and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/privacy): Privacy practices and data handling information for Wiley users.

## Company and News
- [About Wiley](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/about): Overview of Wiley’s business, mission, and areas of focus.
- [Leadership](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/about/leadership): Information about Wiley’s executive leadership team.
- [Newsroom](https://newsroom.wiley.com/): Corporate news, press releases, and announcements from Wiley.
- [Careers](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/careers): Career opportunities and workplace information at Wiley.
- [Investors](https://investors.wiley.com/): Investor relations, financial reports, and governance information.
- [Corporate Citizenship](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/about/corporate-citizenship): Information on Wiley’s social impact and responsibility initiatives.
